A mother sloth will cling tightly to her baby in the treetops.
The boy was too feeble to carry the object very far.
She was reluctant to say that she saw the robbery.

words.zh: 浑浊的，不清晰的；使难以理解

words.ex: Gina was vehement when she found out that Liz was bad in school.
Aaron often preached about living an honest life.
She was terrified to find out her son had been kidnapped.

words.zh: 显而易见的，明显的；专利
words.ex: He quickly established a patent for his brilliant invention.
I dissolved the pill in a glass of water.
The Earth’s oceans are filled with a tremendous amount of water.
The company totaled its aggregate sales for the entire year.

words.zh: 不言而喻的，心照不宣的

words.ex: Sweating is an inherent bodily function when exercising.

words.zh: 有弹性的；能(迅速从伤痛中)恢复的
words.ex: He attached the elastic bungee to his legs before he jumped of the platform.

words.zh: 羞辱，使丧失名誉；怀疑，不相信
杂乱无序地发展，蔓生，蔓延

words.ex: Don’t stand on that leg because there is a fracture. It might get worse.

words.zh: 正式提出；考虑周到的，关心同情的
words.ex: The meat was so tender they didn’t need knives to cut it.

words.zh: 注意细节的，一丝不苟的
使重获新生，使焕然一新

words.ex: The doctor manipulated the data to make it look like the cure was working.
The toy cars are available in an array of colors.

words.zh: 无生气的，缺乏活力的；苍白无血色的

words.ex: Her method of solving the math problem seemed viable.
Her bodyguards escorted her to the movie theater.
Bernie made a deliberate attempt to injure Andy.

words.zh: 有据可依的，无懈可击的

words.ex: The car broke down on the road and obstructed traffic for hours.

words.zh: 审查并删除不良的东西
words.ex: To protect innocent people, the location of the bomb was censored.

words.zh: 极冷的；冷漠的，无感情的
引起争论的；好争论的，好战的
外表；(由内而外散发的)氛围，气场
非常精确的；精确定位或确认
words.ex: The navigation system in my car is able to pinpoint my exact location.
He found himself lost because he had strayed from the tour group.
That group of people making animal noises sounds completely absurd.
The mail accumulated in their mailbox while they were on vacation.
My vacation in Hawaii was like being in paradise.

words.zh: 漠视，不关注；缺乏兴趣，缺乏关心
刮擦(以发出刺耳的声音)；骚扰，惹恼
明智的；小心谨慎的，审慎的
不和谐，刺身；不一致，分歧
牢固的，不可动摇的；健康的，强壮的；(逻辑上)严谨的
words.ex: The alarm clock sounded and woke us all up.

words.zh: 懦弱的，胆小得令人鄙视的
宽容的，善良的；气候温和的
心情好的；给人希望的，象征好运的
热爱冒险的人；大胆的，鲁莽的

words.ex: The other students ridicule Peter’s foreign accent.
Many people like to go to casinos to gamble.
